description: Implementation of a helper class for creating and validating JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) with user claims, extending JwtHelper, in the org.eclipse.hono.service.auth package.

classes.name: AuthTokenHelperImpl
classes.description: A concrete class implementing token creation and validation logic, extending JwtHelper and implementing AuthTokenHelper interface.

methods.name: forSigning
methods.description: Creates an AuthTokenHelper configured for signing tokens, using provided Vertx instance and configuration properties.

methods.name: forValidating
methods.description: Creates an AuthTokenHelper for validating tokens, using provided Vertx instance and configuration properties.

methods.name: forSharedSecret
methods.description: Creates an AuthTokenHelper for creating and validating HMAC SHA256 tokens using a shared secret and expiration policy.

methods.name: createToken
methods.description: Generates a signed JWT with specified authorization ID and authorities, setting issuer and expiration.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Parses and validates a JWT string, returning its claims.
